name: Amarantha Fitch
source:
Her name is Amarantha Fitch, but her friends call her Amy. She's attending her first year of college for creative writing. She'd always loved to write poetry and prose, so it was a natural fit. She had to take a part-time job during summer to pay for her studies, though.

[edited from [url=http://www.winterwolves.com/rememberme.htm]official site[/url]]
